title: AlphaTensor: new algorithms for matrix multiplication
summary: A reinforcement-learning agent found matrix-multiplication algorithms better than known ones for many sizes (for example, 76 multiplications instead of 80 for 4×5 by 5×5). Algorithms optimized for hardware were 10–20% faster on V100 GPUs and TPU v2. The improvement over Strassen applies in a finite field.

evidence.tested: Algorithms are provably correct by construction and their multiplication counts are compared with known methods; hardware-targeted algorithms were benchmarked on V100 GPU and TPU v2.
evidence.unknown: The page lists no formal limitations; it notes the search space is very large and the work is specific to matrix multiplication.
evidence.ai_role: Reinforcement-learning agent searched for tensor decompositions giving new matrix-multiplication algorithms.
